name: sticker-pop
title: Sticker Pop
description: Flat bright field with thick-outlined paper stickers popping in with overshoot: a price tag that counts up, a BARU burst, a PROMO pill, small chips and a mascot sidekick with a speech sticker.
useWhen: A cheerful promo for a food stall, laundry, drink or service: a price, a BARU or PROMO label and a few perks.
The tone is playful and flat, and the frame should feel like a sticker sheet.
avoidWhen: The look should be premium, quiet or photographic: stickers with hard shadows are loud.
You need a product photo: this block only draws flat shapes.
author: Mosio
